records.subject: Li:nFSI (n = 1, 3, 5)/PEDOT:PSS counterion exchange
records.object: Thermoelectric power factor: 0.8 to 157 mu W m K-2
records.quote: In this work, we report a counterion exchange between ionic liquid bis(x-fluorosulfonyl) amide lithium (Li:nFSI, n = 1, 3, 5) with different sizes of anions and a PEDOT:PSS-induced bipolaron network, which significantly boosted the thermoelectric power factor from 0.8 to 157 mu W m K-2 at 235 degrees C and the maximum tensile strain from 30% to over 30%.
records.conditions: At 235 degrees C; Li:nFSI anions have different sizes.
records.note: Power-factor unit retained as supplied; its formatting is ambiguous.
